entries.title: Phoenix Red added
entries.details: New guide with the Pokédex, Wild Encounters and Items tabs.

entries.title: Updated for Crestfall 2.0
entries.details: Keldeo is now listed as roaming. Added the Tera Orb, Bottle Caps, Auspicious and Malicious Armor and the type Tera Shards to the Items tab, plus a second Master Ball source. Added a Join the Discord button.

entries.title: Discord invite link updated
entries.details: The Riverteal Discord button now uses a permanent invite link.

entries.title: Privacy-friendly visit counter added
entries.details: Added an anonymous visit counter (GoatCounter) to every guide. Nothing about the guides' content changed.

entries.title: Items tab added; guide rebuilt for v2.1.9.1 Experimental
entries.details: Pokédex, Wild Encounters and the new Items tab now match the current Experimental build.

entries.title: White Flute and Soul Dew added; areas reordered
entries.details: Added White Flute (Grindel City) and Soul Dew (held by Latias and Latios). Wild Encounters areas now follow the story order from Route 310 onward.

entries.title: Items tabs added
entries.details: Every item with a confirmed location, with where to get it and shop prices. TMs and HMs show the move they teach. Crestfall was also checked against ROM v1.2.5.

entries.title: Updated for the creator's latest release
entries.details: Pokédex, moves, encounters and items updated for the new version. The water route label now reads River route.

entries.title: Areas updated at the creator's request
entries.details: Removed seven areas that are not in the game. Routes 303 and 314 are listed again with No wild encounters.

entries.title: Items tab added; fishing and route order corrected
entries.details: Added the Items tab. Fishing now uses the hack's single Rod, and the first areas follow the order you reach them.

entries.title: Fixed a malformed Mega name
entries.details: One Mega Dragonite entry showed a doubled letter in its name.
